TREATMENT OF CANCER OF THE CERVIX
Treatment
- Examination Under Anaesthesia
  · Staging and Biopsy
· Treatment of invasive carcinoma of the cervix can be:
  · Surgery
  · Radiotherapy
  · Surgery plus radiotherapy
  · Chemo-radiation

Stages I to IIA
- Surgery or radiotherapy (as primary modes of treatment respectively)
  · Radiotherapy can be used as primary mode of treatment in all stages of the disease

Follow up
- This is for life. Regular cytology of vault smears for early detection and prompt treatment of recurrence.

Prevention
Adequate screening programmes:
- Regular Papanicolaou smear screening,
- Visual inspection of the cervix after acetic acid lavage (VIA). Or Visual inspection of the cervix with lugol iodine (VIL).
- HPV vaccines.
- Avoidance of multiple sexual partners
